installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Cloudflare R2 Uploader Automatic Installer & Builder
apk add --no-cache git ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p data

git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "[Installer] Updating repository..."
    git pull origin ${GIT_BRANCH}
else
    echo "[Installer] Cloning from ${GIT_ADDRESS} (${GIT_BRANCH})..."
    git clone --single-branch --branch ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
fi

echo "[Installer] Compiling Go production binary..."
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ${SERVER_BINARY} ./cmd/server
chmod +x ${SERVER_BINARY}

if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    cp .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Build successful! Binary: ${SERVER_BINARY}"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
